name: @quilty/shared-types
description: OpenAPI-emitted TypeScript types from the Rust backend (utoipa -> openapi-typescript), generated from the committed specs in spec/ per ADR-0003. Regenerate with `pnpm --filter @quilty/shared-types codegen`; CI runs `codegen:check` to gate drift between spec/ and src/generated/.

scripts.build: echo 'no build until OpenAPI codegen activates' && exit 0
scripts.codegen: openapi-typescript spec/auth_v2_openapi.yaml -o src/generated/auth.ts --immutable --enum && openapi-typescript spec/sync_openapi.yaml -o src/generated/sync.ts --immutable --enum
scripts.codegen:check: openapi-typescript spec/auth_v2_openapi.yaml -o src/generated/auth.ts --immutable --enum --check && openapi-typescript spec/sync_openapi.yaml -o src/generated/sync.ts --immutable --enum --check
scripts.lint: echo 'no lint until source lands' && exit 0
scripts.test: echo 'no tests until source lands' && exit 0
